lines.text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\c
If it isn’t the child. It seems we are fated to meet
once again.\c
You have come at a truly opportune time.
I was just thinking that I wanted to test my
newly refined sinister techniques...
in a battle that will end in your utter defeat!
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\nToday I’ll not only defeat you, but I will also\r\ndemonstrate my fatherly dignity to my daughter!

KOGA: With Trainers like you
and [VAR TRNAME(0001)],\c
the Pokémon League must be a place
of formidable strength!
Truly, it is something to be proud of!\c
As it so happens, I have been thinking
of aiming to join the Elite Four myself...
